title: Read in Daily Life · Forms, Receipts, Menus, Invoices, and Schedules
sourceLabel: 提供PDF Task 2 · PDF 116–124ページ／冊子192–199ページ · Form Example問1–2・Test問01–15
verificationNote: 原本ページで例題、6つの実用文書、本文、金額、日時、設問、選択肢、順序を照合しました。PDF 116ページは概要、124ページは演習のない終端ページです。例題2問は紙面掲載の解答表示と一致しています。Test 15問は出版社の巻末解答表（冊子450ページ）が未提供のため、文書の明示情報と一意に導ける推論に基づく編集解答です。

passages.dance_survey:
Class Satisfaction Survey

Thank you for taking a class at Rhythm Street Dance Academy! Your feedback helps us improve our classes and provide the best possible experience. Please take a moment to fill out this survey. Upon completion, you will receive a 10 percent discount on your next class.

Student Name: Kathy Chen
Course Name: Hip-Hop Foundations
Instructor Name: Ethan Brooks

Ratings (Poor / Fair / Good / Excellent)
Quality of Instruction: Excellent
Class Choreography: Good
Music Selection: Excellent
Facility: Good

Comment:
The instructor had amazing energy and really made the class fun! The choreography was challenging but manageable. The studio space was clean and spacious, perfect for practicing. However, the ventilation in the practice room could be better. It felt a bit stuffy during the class after a lot of activity. I'm excited to continue my dance journey here!

questions.prompt: What will Ms. Chen receive after completing the survey?

options.label: A
options.text: A discount on studio rentals

options.label: B
options.text: A free class voucher

options.label: C
options.text: A free guest pass for a friend

options.label: D
options.text: A discount on the tuition fee

questions.answer: The instructions promise a 10 percent discount on her next class, which is a reduction in the class tuition fee. 正解：D（紙面掲載の解答と一致）。

questions.answer: She says the ventilation could be better and that the room felt stuffy. 正解：C（紙面掲載の解答と一致）。The choreography was challenging but manageable, and the studio was spacious.
